paper_title: RLHF Workflow From Reward Modeling to Online RLHF
caption: The training record of reward modeling. From the left to right, we present the records of training loss, gradient norm, and the learning rate, respectively.
model_annotation: The plot shows the training loss trajectory of a reward model over the course of training. The x-axis is labeled “Training Step,” uses a linear scale, and spans approximately 0 to 1400 with regularly spaced tick labels at 200-step intervals (0, 200, 400, …, 1400). The y-axis is labeled “Training Loss,” uses a linear scale, and displays values roughly from about 0.25 up to about 0.78, with major tick labels visible at 0.3, 0.4, 0.5, 0.6, and 0.7 (0.1 increments). A single blue solid line (no markers) labeled “Training Loss of Reward Model” starts near about 0.76 at step 0, drops steeply in the early steps to around the mid-0.4s by roughly the first ~50–100 steps, then continues to decrease more gradually with small step-to-step fluctuations; around the mid-training region (e.g., near 600 steps) it sits near ~0.33, and by the end of the shown range (around 1400 steps) it oscillates around ~0.30 with occasional dips slightly below 0.30 and brief spikes slightly above ~0.32–0.33.
